newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks drift down, red chips soaring.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks drift down, red chips soaring.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks drifted in modestly negative territory on Friday afternoon, with investor attention focused on the red-hot red-chip sector, brokers said.

"Technically, most of the red chips are very overbought and due for a correction," said Charles Cheung, executive director at J&A Securities. "Turnover on red chips is at a record high, indicating there is already a lot of selling."
The Hang Seng Index was trading 66 points or 0.52 percent down at 12,660 on heavy turnover of HK$12.06 billion.
China Merchants Hai Hong continued to be the most actively traded issue. The share was HK$0.85 higher at HK$8.70 on turnover of HK$861 million.
Banking giant HSBC Holdings eased HK$1.50 to HK$189.00 on volume of HK$510 million.
